name: Alhama de Almería (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alhama de Almería (a bunch of grapes on green above a bath house).
history: Municipal flag of Alhama de Almería; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alhama de Almería arms — grapes and bath house
